titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Nauka i technika — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Science & Technology — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Nauka i technika: wynalazki, komputer, internet, urządzenia. Listy do gier LingoSpark.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Science & technology module: inventions, computers, the internet, gadgets. Paste into LingoSpark games.

items.definitionEn: to create something that did not exist before
items.example: Who was the first person to invent the telephone?

items.definitionEn: a new thing that someone has created
items.example: The internet is the most important invention of recent times.

items.definitionEn: to find something that was not known before
items.example: Scientists may discover a new planet one day.

items.definitionEn: a person who studies science and does experiments
items.example: The scientist explained the results of the test.

items.definitionEn: a scientific test to learn what happens
items.example: We did an experiment with magnets in science.

items.definitionEn: a room where scientists do tests
items.example: Do not run in the laboratory.

items.definitionEn: a machine or tool made for a particular job
items.example: A tablet is a useful device for reading on the train.

items.definitionEn: a small, clever electronic object
items.example: This gadget can find your lost keys.

items.definitionEn: a mobile phone that can use the internet and apps
items.example: Leave your smartphone in your bag during the test.

items.definitionEn: the object that puts power into a battery
items.example: I forgot my charger, so the phone died.

items.definitionEn: working without a cable
items.example: The school has wireless internet in every classroom.

items.definitionEn: to copy a file from the internet onto your device
items.example: Do not download apps from unknown websites.

items.definitionEn: to send a file from your device to the internet
items.example: Upload your homework to the school platform.

items.definitionEn: to enter a username and password to use a site
items.example: Log in before you start the online quiz.

items.definitionEn: a secret word that lets you open an account
items.example: Never share your password with classmates.

items.definitionEn: the name you use to log in
items.example: Choose a username that is not your real name.

items.definitionEn: websites and apps for sharing news and photos with others
items.example: Too much social media can steal your homework time.

items.definitionEn: a message you put on the internet; to put it there
items.example: Do not post photos of other people without asking.

items.definitionEn: to let other people see a file or post
items.example: She did not want to share the video with the whole class.

items.definitionEn: a website that finds pages when you type words
items.example: Use a search engine to check the spelling.

items.definitionEn: a small program on a phone or tablet
items.example: I downloaded a new app to learn English words.

items.definitionEn: the programs that a computer runs
items.example: The school will update the software in the computer room.

items.definitionEn: the physical parts of a computer
items.example: A keyboard is hardware, not software.

items.definitionEn: the part that stores electricity in a device
items.example: My laptop battery lasts only two hours.

items.definitionEn: to connect a device to electricity
items.example: Plug in the laptop before the lesson starts.

items.definitionEn: to stop a machine working
items.example: Switch off your phone in the cinema.

items.definitionEn: to make a paper copy from a computer
items.example: Print the worksheet on both sides of the paper.

items.definitionEn: to store a document so you do not lose it
items.example: Save a file every few minutes when you write.

items.definitionEn: to remove a file or message
items.example: Do not delete your draft before the teacher has seen it.

items.definitionEn: connected to the internet
items.example: The test will be online on Friday morning.

items.definitionEn: not connected to the internet
items.example: You can play this game offline on the train.

items.definitionEn: a machine that can do jobs, often automatically
items.example: A robot vacuums the floor in their house.

items.definitionEn: an object in space that sends signals to Earth
items.example: Your phone uses a satellite to show your location.

items.definitionEn: a device that turns sunlight into electricity
items.example: The school roof has a solar panel.

items.definitionEn: something you wear on your ears to listen to sound
items.example: You need headphones so you do not disturb other people.

items.definitionEn: the part of a device that shows pictures and text
items.example: Do not sit too close to the screen.
